combo_label: School Days × Baking & Cakes × Sherlock Holmes

entries.clue: Single-serving sponge in a paper case, crowned with a swirl of buttercream
Coded message, dancing stick figures perhaps, waiting to be broken open
Squeezing frosting through a nozzle to make rosettes and swirls
One taught in a class, or the dark spot at the centre of your eye
Landlady who climbs seventeen steps with the breakfast tray to the lodgers
Spectral beast said to stalk a wealthy Devon family down the generations
Two-wheeled cab with the driver perched high behind, reins over the roof
Soft, stretchy lump worked by hand and left to rise, or slang for cash
Where PE happens indoors, among wall bars, ropes and vaulting horses
Living fungus whose bubbles of gas lift a whole loaf
Adding and taking away, worked in a column down the page
Lemon's grated yellow in a cake mix, or great enthusiasm
